RANSHINGE

	Senior Software Engineer

	+91 9370565876

	

ranshingekamlesh12@gmail.
com

	EDUCATION

	BE (Bachelors 
of Engineering) 
Pune University 
(2016-2020)

	

RELEVANT SKILLS

		• API Automation Testing
	• IntelliJ, Maven, Eclipse
	• Rest Assured, Postman, SOAP UI
	• Selenium WebDriver
	• BDD Cucumber
	• Core JAVA, TestNG/JUnit
	• Mobile Testing
	• APPIUM GUI, Inspector
	• Browser Stack, Real Device Testing
	• Android Studio, X-code
	• UI Automation
	• Agile/Scrum M e t h o d o l o g y
	• JIRA/ ALM, Zephyr
	• SQL,
	• GIT-GITHUB, Bitbucket
	• CI/CD (JENKINS)


	• AWS, Azure, Docker




	CAREER OBJECTIVE

	A highly motivated and detail-oriented Software Test Engineer with over 
4+ years of experience in automation testing, API testing, mobile testing, 
and test management. Proficient in Selenium, Appium, Rest Assured, 
Postman, and BDD frameworks, with a strong background in Java, CI/CD 
tools like Jenkins, and Agile methodologies. Seeking to leverage my 
expertise in designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts to 
contribute to the quality assurance and reliability of software products in a 
dynamic and collaborative environment.

	PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

	Senior Software Engineer
VIRTUSA Ltd
	 Designed, developed, and maintained robust automation 
frameworks (Keyword, Data-driven, Hybrid) using 
Selenium, Java, TestNG, and BDD Cucumber to support 
scalable test automation.
	 Collaborated with developers and business analysts to 
implement BDD scenarios using Cucumber, ensuring 
clear traceability between requirements and automated 
tests.
	 Performed mobile testing using Appium GUI Inspector for both 
Android and iOS applications on Browser Stack, ensuring cross- 
device compatibility.
	 Automated API testing using Rest Assured and Postman for REST 
and SOAP services, validating responses and integrating with UI test 
flows.
	 Automated testing of mobile applications using Appium with Java for 
functional, UI and regression Testing
	 Designed and implemented API Automation suite using 
Rest Assured, reducing regression cycle by 50%.
	 Perform schema validation and automated testing of API’s
	 Prepared automation execution reports and defect metrics, 
communicating status updates to stakeholders.
	 Utilized cloud-based test environments (AWS/Azure/Docker) to 
run distributed tests, improving execution efficiency and scalability.
	 Performed code reviews and optimized test scripts for reusability, 
maintainability, and execution performance.
	 Works with clients to identify business, technical, and reporting

requirements.

	Test Engineer
INFOSYS Ltd, Pune
	 Proficient in Test Complete & Automation Tools.
	 Contributed to process improvements, test strategy 
discussions, and root cause analysis for critical defects.
	 Experience in creating Test Scripting in BDD Cucumber and 
logging defects in JIRA.
	 Conducted automation feasibility studies and identified test 
cases suitable for automation to optimize ROI.
	 Analyze and documents test results and defects, collaborating 
with developers and project managers to ensure timely 
delivery of quality
	 Collaborated with developers and DevOps teams to implement 
Continuous Testing using Jenkins, Bitbucket, and Maven.
